set.body: From the cold review of 97161f239. The role guard checks only self-declared role strings. Manifest sha256 values are not validated, even syntactically, and duplicate roles and an empty manifest pass. The presence receipt is not bound to the manifest's annotation hash. Hints accept any ContributoryBasis and direction (harmless because hints decide nothing, but should be stated or narrowed).
set.title: S3c-1 follow-up F2: bind input manifest and presence receipts to checked hashes
